name: sf90-ebay-screening
note: The same clean anchor with recorded eBay Browse item summaries beside it: the suite runs the live comps fetcher over them, so the fixed-price rule and the exotic whole-vehicle floor are graded on the evidence the assessor would use. Item summaries recorded 2026-08-17 from Browse Cars & Trucks; the auction, the parts-priced spoiler and the listing that declares no buying option are the screening cases.

areas.description: Front bumper cover, splitter, and headlight assemblies torn off/missing on both corners; underlying crash can and radiator support visible but no visible bending of aluminum rails.
Right front wheel well torn open, brake caliper and control arms exposed; wheel sits at a slightly odd angle suggesting possible suspension displacement, but tire/wheel itself not visibly bent.
Left front fender/bumper area torn away exposing suspension and brake components; no obvious bent control arms visible in photo.
Rear bumper fascia and diffuser cover removed, exposing exhaust, hybrid inverter, and wiring harness; bumper beam and structure behind look straight and undamaged.
Hybrid high-voltage components (orange cabling, inverter box) exposed at both front and rear due to missing fascias; isolation/HV integrity unverified from photos.
Cabin appears clean and undamaged, seats and dash intact, no airbag deployment evident.
Front wheels/suspension exposed due to missing bumpers; no confirmed bent components but front impact likely stressed lower control arms and steering rack given extent of fascia loss.

observations.note: Front clip completely torn off exposing front suspension, brake calipers, and crash structure; heavy impact damage to right front corner.
Left side view shows front bumper/fender torn away, left front wheel/suspension exposed; rear bumper cover also missing exposing hybrid components and exhaust.
Rear quarter view shows rear bumper fascia removed exposing hybrid electrical harness, exhaust tips, and diffuser structure; no visible structural rail deformation.
Front right corner missing bumper and headlight area, front crash can/hybrid inverter box exposed; wheel appears upright, no obvious camber change visible here.
Overhead front view confirms bumper cover and front fascia torn off both corners, headlights displaced, but hood and front frame rails appear straight.
Rear straight-on view shows bumper cover removed exposing exhaust, hybrid motor/inverter unit, and wiring; rear crash structure and bumper beam visible but not visibly bent.
Interior driver seat area intact, no airbag deployment visible, no fire/flood staining.
Interior passenger/dash view intact, steering wheel airbag cover appears intact/unfired.
Instrument cluster shows only 3,004 miles, multiple warning lights (battery, system not programmed) consistent with disconnected 12V/HV systems for storage, not necessarily damage indicator.
Rear engine cover/glass area shown; some minor surface scuffing near louvers but panel intact, no crush.
Hood/front fascia area shows panel gaps but hood itself unbent, minor gap misalignment from missing bumper.
VIN and Ferrari data plate tag, confirms SF90 Stradale identity, no damage info.

triage.drivetrainRisk: Front and rear fascias are torn off exposing hybrid inverter, wiring, and exhaust, but the mid-engine V8/hybrid powertrain itself isn't visible in these shots; low mileage (3,004 mi) is a plus, though HV isolation must be verified before any bench work given exposed orange cabling front and rear.
